cases.case: an app with accounts on the installation's domain
cases.error: This app has accounts or is private, so a path address on konae.es shares its origin with the home and every other app there. Any other app on konae.es, including other owners' apps, can use the sessions of this app's users. The app's own hostname keeps its sessions on its own origin. Set acceptSharedOrigin to true to accept this, or close signup and keep every action anonymous so the app has no sessions to share.
